name: audit-before-edits
assertion: A new project has a complete evidence-based fourteen-section audit before the other four project documents or implementation; working-tree and clean-commit baselines are distinguished.

name: shared-primary-optional-overlay
assertion: The shared method is used when no overlay exists, without creating one automatically or forcing a foreign storage architecture; existing overlays contain only verified local differences.

name: all-actions-bottom-ledger
assertion: The tracker ends with an append-only Action Log recording all meaningful reads/inventory, decisions, writes, commands, tests, deployments, delegation, failures and verification with timestamp, actor, scope, result and evidence; historical entries and secret values are not modified or exposed.

name: delegation-reconciled
assertion: Before completion, the coordinator reconciles each delegated worker's action ledger and evidence into the owning tracker; receiving a result alone cannot complete the task.

name: conservative-archival
assertion: Triage treats in-progress checkboxes as unfinished and rejects archival candidates without five documents, complete audit, final Action Log and explicit readiness evidence; actual evidence is reviewed before moves.

name: truthful-hook-boundary
assertion: Issue/PR hooks run actual local documentation checks and propagate failures, while never describing local checks as remote GitHub validation or PR approval.

name: sanctioned-tests
assertion: Post-edit helper fixture tests run on the repository's sanctioned host in background, with command, counts, exit status and durable logs; the main suite's exclusions are not misrepresented as helper coverage.
